requires_build.runs: the C compiler on its code

backends.safety: gopls runs in a mirror of the repository with the user's Go (PATH and GOROOT from the detected toolchain, set by servers/go.rs) and the user's module cache read-only: GOPROXY=off, GOSUMDB=off (no downloads), GOTOOLCHAIN=local (no toolchain switch), GOENV=off (GOMODCACHE / GOPATH passed explicitly), GOTELEMETRY=off, GOCACHE outside the mirror; no GOFLAGS (the default -mod=readonly or vendor applies) and no GOWORK override (go.work is honoured). CGO_ENABLED=0 unless the project has cgo files and trace index --allow-build was given (then CGO_ENABLED=1 runs the C compiler over the cgo preambles). gopls itself is built by `go install` with the user's Go into the tools folder, version chosen by the Go minor, module hashes verified by the Go checksum database.
